claim: Training is recommended as part of certification preparation, but it is not mandatory for completing the certification.
question: Is any training course required before taking an AWS Certification exam?

values.display: not mandatory for the completion of the certification

evidence.quote: Training is recommended as part of your certification preparation, but it is not mandatory for the completion of the certification.

note: FAQ quick-fire; also before-testing: 'All AWS Certifications may be earned without completing specific prerequisites.'

claim: All AWS Certifications may be earned without completing specific prerequisites.
question: Does the Solutions Architect - Associate exam require another certification first?

evidence.quote: All AWS Certifications may be earned without completing specific prerequisites. However, AWS provides recommendations for knowledge and experience that are aligned to the content and level of proficiency for each certification.

claim: The recommended experience before taking the Solutions Architect - Associate exam is at least 1 year of hands-on experience designing cloud solutions that use AWS services.
question: How much hands-on experience does AWS recommend before the Solutions Architect - Associate exam?

values.display: at least 1 year of hands-on experience
values.spoken: at least one year of hands-on experience

evidence.quote: Per the exam guide, the recommended experience prior to taking this exam is at least 1 year of hands-on experience designing cloud solutions that use AWS services.

claim: The exam uses short names for some AWS services, and the list of short names with their full names is available through the Help button in the exam.
question: Does the exam spell out every AWS service name, and where can a candidate look up a short name during the exam?

values.display: the Help button in the exam

evidence.quote: This exam uses short names of some AWS services. A list of short names and corresponding full names will be available through the Help button in the exam.
AWS Certification is reducing the reading load on this exam by using official short names for well-known AWS service names that contain abbreviations or parenthetical information.

note: Reading-load tip for the reader; cause code W.

note: FAQ quick-fire; the number of business days is a numbers-lens fact.
